solidworks_session_stuck_status.doc: Report whether SolidWorks looks stuck, requiring both a missing response and no live solver process. Read-only; it stays conservative on purpose, because a long solve also looks unresponsive and killing it would interrupt real work.

solidworks_session_solver_processes.doc: List the solver and mesher kernel processes that are running right now. Read-only; use it to tell a solve that is still working from one that crashed, and to confirm that a solver really exited.

solidworks_session_wait_until_idle.doc: Wait until SolidWorks reports idle or the timeout expires, and say whether idle was reached. Read-only polling: it never touches the model, and it always returns instead of waiting forever.

params.timeout: Maximum wait in seconds before giving up; defaults to 60.0.
params.interval: Seconds between two busy checks; defaults to 3.0.

solidworks_topology_collect_numbers.doc: Read a solved topology study's result numbers, including the plot names and the material-mass plot. Read-only; a study that has not been solved reports no results instead of raising.

params.study_name: Name of an existing topology study; empty uses the first study in the document. Defaults to empty.

solidworks_topology_list_constraints.doc: Report which constraints and controls already exist on a topology study, as booleans plus a count. Read-only, and it never returns COM objects; a kind counts as present only when it was actually retrieved.

params.study_name: Name of an existing topology study; empty uses the first study in the document. Defaults to empty.

solidworks_topology_manager_report.doc: Report whether the topology study manager exists, what object type it is and which constraint kinds are retrievable. Read-only, and the COM object itself is never returned.

params.study_name: Name of an existing topology study; empty uses the first study in the document. Defaults to empty.

solidworks_topology_options_report.doc: Report whether the topology study options object exists and what type it is. Read-only, and the COM object itself is never returned.

params.study_name: Name of an existing topology study; empty uses the first study in the document. Defaults to empty.

solidworks_topology_set_goal.doc: Set the topology study goal and report the retrievable constraint count before and after. It modifies study parameters only and never runs the solver; ok means the call did not raise and the count did not drop.

params.study_name: Name of an existing topology study; empty uses the first study in the document. Defaults to empty.
params.goal_type: Topology goal type value taken from the topology goal enum; defaults to 0.
params.mass_reduce_percent: Target mass reduction in percent, where 75 means a 75 percent reduction; defaults to 0.0, which keeps the document default.

solidworks_topology_set_iteration_option.doc: Set the topology iteration options and report the retrievable constraint count before and after. It modifies study parameters only and never runs the solver; the option values stay at the capability layer defaults because their enum is not verified here.

params.study_name: Name of an existing topology study; empty uses the first study in the document. Defaults to empty.

solidworks_section_properties.doc: Read the section properties of the current selection. Not read-only: the official member clears and rewrites the selection set, and the returned area unit is unverified, so treat it as a number without a unit.

solidworks_scale_feature.doc: Create a scale feature that scales the body by the given factors. It writes a new feature into the active part; the factors are dimensionless ratios, so 2.0 doubles the body and 0.5 halves it.

params.scale_type: Scale type passed to the official call; 0, 1 and 2 are the values this repository has verified. Defaults to 1.
params.uniform: Whether the three directions share one factor; true uses only x_factor. Defaults to true.
params.x_factor: Scale ratio along X, dimensionless, where 2.0 doubles the body. Defaults to 2.0.
params.y_factor: Scale ratio along Y, dimensionless. Defaults to 2.0.
params.z_factor: Scale ratio along Z, dimensionless. Defaults to 2.0.

solidworks_untrim_surface.doc: Untrim a surface so a trimmed face or edge grows back, adding that as a new feature. It writes a feature into the active part, works only on surface parts with the face or edges preselected, and its positive case has not been built on this machine yet.

params.face_untrim_type: Face untrim option from the official enum, listed in the returned face_untrim_types table; defaults to 0.
params.edge_untrim_type: Edge untrim option from the official enum, listed in the returned edge_untrim_types table; defaults to 0.
params.distance_mm: Extension distance in millimetres; the official parameter gives no unit, so the millimetre reading is an assumption reported back. Defaults to 0.0.
params.merge: Whether to merge the resulting surfaces; defaults to true.
params.trim_opposite_side: Whether to untrim the opposite side as well; defaults to false.

solidworks_sweep_surface.doc: Create a swept surface from a profile and a path, and report the new feature. It writes a surface feature into the active part; the profile must be selected with mark 1 and the path with mark 4, a closed path is known to fail, and a missing selection returns nothing without raising.

params.propagate: Official propagate flag; defaults to true.
params.twist_ctrl: Official twist control option value; defaults to 0.
params.keep_tangency: Official keep-tangency flag; defaults to true.
params.advanced_smoothing: Official advanced-smoothing flag; defaults to false.
params.start_matching: Official start matching type value; defaults to 0.
params.end_matching: Official end matching type value; defaults to 0.
params.path_align: Official path alignment value, meaningful only with certain twist control options; defaults to 0.
params.use_feat_scope: Official feature scope flag; defaults to false.
params.use_auto_select: Official auto-select flag; false means the caller must select the bodies. Defaults to true.
params.twist_angle_deg: Twist angle in degrees, meaningful only with a twist option; defaults to 0.0.
params.merge_smooth_faces: Official merge-smooth-faces flag; defaults to false.

solidworks_weldment_trim.doc: Skip this tool, NOT USABLE on this machine: trimming or extending weldment bodies adds no feature. It would write a weldment trim feature after you select the bodies with mark 1 and the boundaries with mark 2, but eight measured option combinations left the feature tree unchanged.

params.end_cond: End condition from the weldment end-condition enum: 0=none, 1=miter, 2=butt1, 3=butt2, 4=trim, 5=use default. Defaults to 0.
params.options: Option bits combined as a logical sum: 1, 2, 4 and 8. Defaults to 0.
params.gap_mm: Trim gap in millimetres; the official parameter gives no unit, so the millimetre reading is an assumption reported back. Defaults to 0.0.

solidworks_export_flat_pattern_dxf.doc: Export the sheet-metal flat pattern of the active part to a DXF file for cutting. Writes the file, and refuses to run unless the part is already saved or allow_temporary_save is true.

params.include_bend_lines: Whether to write the bend lines. Defaults to true.
params.include_sketches: Whether to write the sketches. Defaults to false.
params.include_hidden_edges: Whether to write hidden edges. Defaults to false.
params.include_bounding_box: Whether to write the bounding box. Defaults to false.
params.merge_coplanar_faces: Whether to merge coplanar faces. Defaults to false.
params.allow_temporary_save: Whether to save the unsaved part into temporary_save_dir first so the official precondition holds. Defaults to false, which keeps the previous behaviour.
params.temporary_save_dir: Directory for that temporary save; must stay inside this repository. Defaults to output/_temp_save.

solidworks_sheet_metal_insert_miter_flan.doc: Insert a sheet-metal miter flange and report the new feature. It writes a feature into the active part; the custom bend allowance is passed as null so the parent bend allowance is used, and no official precondition is documented, so the selection count is reported as unknown.

params.use_default_radius: Whether to use the default bend radius instead of global_radius_mm; defaults to true.
params.global_radius_mm: Global bend radius in millimetres, used only when use_default_radius is false; defaults to 0.0.
params.rip_gap_mm: Rip gap in millimetres; defaults to 0.0.
params.use_default_relief: Whether to use the parent bend relief ratio; defaults to true.
params.use_relief_ratio: Whether to use a custom relief ratio; defaults to false.
params.relief_ratio: Custom relief ratio, a dimensionless fraction such as 0.6; defaults to 0.0.
params.relief_width_mm: Relief width in millimetres, used only with a custom relief ratio and a rectangular or obround relief; defaults to 0.0.
params.relief_depth_mm: Relief depth in millimetres, used under the same conditions as relief_width_mm; defaults to 0.0.
params.trim_side_bends: Whether to trim the side bends; defaults to false.
params.flange_pos: Flange position: 1=material inside, 2=material outside, 3=bend outside, 4=bend centerline, 5=bend sharp, 6=bend tangent. Defaults to 1.
params.offset_dist1_mm: Start offset of a partial flange in millimetres; defaults to 0.0.
params.offset_dist2_mm: End offset of a partial flange in millimetres; defaults to 0.0.

solidworks_sheet_metal_insert_closed_cor.doc: Insert a closed corner on the sheet-metal corners and report the tree, face-count and volume change. It writes a feature into the active part; the official call returns nothing and documents no precondition, so the selection count is reported as unknown rather than as satisfied.

solidworks_weldment_insert_end_cap.doc: Insert a weldment end cap on the end faces you select first, and report the new feature. It writes a feature into the active part and does not pick the faces for you; this entry reads selections with mark 0, unlike the gusset entry that needs mark 1.

params.is_given_offset: True to give an offset value, false to give a thickness ratio; defaults to false.
params.is_chamfer: True to chamfer the end cap, false to fillet it; defaults to false.
params.offset_value_mm: Edge offset in millimetres, used only when is_given_offset is true; defaults to 0.0.
params.wall_ratio: Wall thickness ratio, a dimensionless fraction such as 0.6, used only when is_given_offset is false; defaults to 0.0.
params.chamfer_value_mm: Chamfer distance when is_chamfer is true, otherwise the fillet radius, in millimetres; defaults to 0.0.
params.is_corner_treatment: Whether to chamfer or fillet the end cap corners, valid only when is_given_offset is false; defaults to false.
params.depth_offset_mm: Inset distance in millimetres, valid only when is_end_cap_inward is 2; defaults to 0.0.
params.is_reverse: Whether to reverse the offset or the thickness ratio; defaults to false.
params.is_end_cap_inward: Thickness direction: 0=extend outward, 1=extend inward, 2=specify inset. Defaults to 0.

solidworks_weldment_gusset_create.doc: Insert a weldment gusset between two faces you select with mark 1, and report the new feature. It writes a feature into the active part and reports how many selections sit on mark 1, so a single-face selection shows up instead of looking like a failed feature.

params.loc_type: Profile location along the reference plane: 0=start, 1=center, 2=end. Defaults to 1.
params.is_profile: Whether to use a polygon profile instead of a triangle profile; defaults to false.
params.profile_d1_mm: First profile distance in millimetres; defaults to 0.0.
params.profile_d2_mm: Second profile distance in millimetres; defaults to 0.0.
params.profile_d3_mm: Third profile distance in millimetres; defaults to 0.0.
params.profile_angle_deg: Profile angle in degrees, valid only when use_len_dim is false; defaults to 45.0.
params.profile_d4_mm: Fourth profile distance in millimetres, valid only when use_len_dim is true; defaults to 0.0.
params.offset_reference_plane: Whether to offset the reference plane of the gusset sketch; defaults to false.
params.d_profile_offset_mm: Offset of that reference plane in millimetres; defaults to 0.0.
params.crv_index: Index of the edge to use when several edges intersect; defaults to 0.
params.reverse_dir: Whether to reverse the offset direction; defaults to false.
params.reverse_face: Whether to reverse the profile distances; defaults to false.
params.use_len_dim: True to dimension with profile_d4_mm, false to use profile_angle_deg; defaults to false.
params.profile_d5_mm: First chamfer distance in millimetres, used only when need_chamfer_in_gusset is true; defaults to 0.0.
params.profile_d6_mm: Second chamfer distance in millimetres, used only when the chamfer flags allow it; defaults to 0.0.
params.profile_chamfer_angle_deg: Chamfer angle in degrees, used instead of profile_d6_mm when use_len_dim_for_chamfer is false; defaults to 45.0.
params.use_len_dim_for_chamfer: True to dimension the chamfer with profile_d6_mm, false to use the chamfer angle; defaults to false.
params.need_chamfer_in_gusset: Whether to chamfer the gusset to leave room for a weld bead underneath; defaults to false.

solidworks_surface_midsurface_create.doc: Create surface midsurfaces for one body of the active part and report the new sheet bodies. It writes surface features into the part; the active document must be a part, both body and placement are passed through unchanged, and the tool is registered but not verified on this machine.

params.body_index: Zero-based index of the body, taken from the part solid-body list.
params.placement: Reference surface position, passed through unchanged because the official parameter states neither a unit nor a dimension.
params.knit: True to sew all reference surfaces into one.

solidworks_part_shell.doc: Hollow the part with a wall thickness and report the feature, rebuild and error read-back. It writes a feature into the active part and does not save it; an empty feature_name falls back to the default shell name, and a wrong name reports the feature as absent.

params.thickness_mm: Wall thickness in millimetres, following the document unit.
params.feature_name: Expected feature name used by the read-back; defaults to empty, which falls back to the default shell name, and a wrong name reports the feature as absent.
